methodology.evaluatorInstructions: Evaluate whether the support assistant follows the synthetic booking guide, confirms the requested change, and communicates clearly.

messages.content: You are a support assistant for a fictional workshop booking service. Follow the supplied booking guide.
I booked the Saturday 10 AM watercolor class. Can I move to Sunday afternoon?
I can help with that. Sunday has sessions at 1 PM and 3 PM. Which one would you prefer?
Your booking has been moved to Sunday at 3 PM at no charge. Your confirmation number remains DEMO-1042, and an updated confirmation will be emailed shortly.

configuration.expected: The assistant offers valid Sunday times, asks the user to choose, confirms Sunday at 3 PM, states that the change is free, and explains that an updated confirmation will be sent.

referenceDocuments.content:
# Example Booking Guide

Customers may change sessions without a fee until 24 hours before class. Sunday watercolor sessions begin at 1 PM and 3 PM. After a change, keep the existing confirmation number and send an updated confirmation email.
